action.command: docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost:389 -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w "$(grep LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD /workspace/.ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml | head -2 | tail -1 | sed "s/.*://;s/ //;s/'//g")" -b "dc=example,dc=org" "(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)" dn 2>&1 | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"summary": "Query LDAP for test users", "command": "docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost:389 -D \"cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org\" -w \"$(grep LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD /workspace/.ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml | head -2 | tail -1 | sed \"s/.*://;s/ //;s/'//g\")\" -b \"dc=example,dc=org\" \"(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)\" dn 2>&1 | head -30", "security_risk": "LOW"}
